issue: Closing the composer translator could dismiss the keyboard instead of transferring input to the normal composer.
fixes: Use one optional ComposerFocus state for both English and Chinese fields, with direct transfer to English when closing an active translator.
Hide the source controls through visibility, hit testing and accessibility without disabling the focused subtree during responder transfer.
Only user-driven message scrolling participates in interactive keyboard dismissal; composer resizing and programmatic scrolling do not.

checks: Focus transfers from Chinese to English, preserves draft and accepts typing without another tap.
Keyboard and composer position remain stable after mode animation and further typing.
Closing while English has focus keeps the keyboard.
Closing with the keyboard deliberately hidden leaves it hidden.

regression.note: These two routes passed on final product code. The translator position assertion in that run sampled its initial position before keyboard layout stabilized; the final translator run waits for the initial keyboard layout and passes the corrected assertion.

limits: Local Debug fixture only; no live translation, AI requests or production data.
Device Hub screen capture was unavailable in this session; native UI test screenshots were inspected.
